findings.title: Grouped Make output discards flushed diagnostics from a timed-out peer
findings.reproduction: Warm actual Make graph; megatruss double exits29 after seeded peer starts; seeded flushes stdout/stderr and hangs; production run_timed_command expires after1s. Grouped final command.log lacks both peer markers; identical invocation without --output-sync=target retains them.
findings.impact: Correct nonpassing timeout receipt and child cleanup remain, but partial stdout/stderr needed to diagnose the stalled sanitizer case is lost.
findings.required_change: Preserve independently retained per-case raw output through timeout/cancellation and bind/upload it, or use a diagnostic approach that demonstrably retains partial output.
